name: Blogibot – Smart AI for SEO-Ready Blog Creation & Feed Management
author: Saju Gopal

sections.description:
Blogibot is an innovative WordPress plugin that uses artificial intelligence to automatically create and publish high-quality blog posts for your website. Simply schedule when you want posts to be created, specify the category, and Blogibot does the rest.

Key Features

AI Blog Creation:
* AI-Powered Content Generation: Create unique, engaging blog content with advanced AI technology
* Site Content Analyzer: Analyze your existing content to generate relevant blog topics and ideas
* Smart Topic Suggestions: Get AI-powered blog topic recommendations based on your site’s content
* SEO-Ready Content: Every post comes with optimized meta titles and descriptions (compatible with Yoast SEO)
* Smart Scheduling: Set up automatic blog creation at specific dates and times
* Category-Based Content: Generate content tailored to your WordPress categories
* Instant Generation: Need content right now? Use the “Fetch Now” feature for immediate blog creation

RSS Feed Management:
* Auto-Import from Feeds: Import content automatically from RSS/Atom feeds
* Multi-Feed Support: Manage multiple feed sources with individual settings
* Flexible Scheduling: Set fetch frequency (hourly, every 6 hours, daily, weekly, or manual)
* Content Filtering: Filter imported posts by keywords and minimum length
* Duplicate Prevention: Automatically prevent importing duplicate content
* Featured Image Import: Auto-import and set featured images from feeds
* Attribution & SEO: Add source attribution and canonical tags for proper SEO
* Cron Integration: Automatic background fetching with WordPress cron system

General:
* User-Friendly Interface: Simple, intuitive controls for managing your content
* Pause and Resume: Flexible scheduling with the ability to pause and resume scheduled posts

How It Works

For AI Blog Creation:
1. Get your API key from Wontonee Apps
2. Enter your API key and domain name in the plugin settings
3. Use the Site Content Analyzer to get topic suggestions based on your existing content
4. Select a category and schedule time for blog creation
5. Let Blogibot automatically create and publish your content

For Feed Management:
1. Navigate to the Feed tab in Blogibot
2. Add RSS/Atom feed sources with your preferred settings
3. Configure import frequency, content filters, and SEO options
4. Blogibot automatically fetches and imports new posts from your feeds
5. Monitor imported posts and manage your feed sources from the dashboard

Blogibot integrates seamlessly with WordPress and respects your existing category structure. Posts are published directly to your blog with appropriate category assignments and SEO metadata.

Perfect For

  • Content marketers looking to maintain regular publishing schedules
  • Website owners who need fresh content but lack time to write
  • SEO professionals seeking to build content around target categories
  • Content curators who want to aggregate content from multiple RSS feeds
  • News sites needing automatic content imports from trusted sources
  • Niche bloggers who want to supplement original content with curated posts
  • Businesses wanting to maintain an active blog presence with minimal effort

Video

Privacy Policy

Blogibot connects to the Wontonee API service to generate content. Your API key, domain name, and selected category are sent to our servers during the content generation process. We do not store your WordPress content or user data beyond what’s necessary to provide the service.

For more information on how your data is handled, please see our full privacy policy at https://wontonee.com/privacy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the blogibot folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘Blogibot AI’ in your admin menu
  4. Enter your API key and domain name (get your API key at Wontonee Apps)
  5. Start scheduling your blog posts by selecting categories and times
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key to use this plugin?

Yes, you need an API key from Wontonee to use Blogibot. Visit Wontonee Apps to obtain your API key.

How is the content quality?

Blogibot uses advanced AI technology to create high-quality, relevant content based on your selected category. The content is designed to be informative and engaging for your audience.

Can I edit the generated posts?

Yes, all generated posts are standard WordPress posts that you can edit just like any manually created content.

Does it work with Yoast SEO?

Yes! Blogibot automatically generates SEO meta titles and descriptions that integrate with Yoast SEO.

Can I schedule multiple posts?

Absolutely! You can schedule as many posts as you need, with each post based on a different category.

Can I pause scheduled posts?

Yes, you can pause and resume scheduled posts at any time from the Blogibot dashboard.

What happens if I delete a scheduled post?

Deleting a scheduled post will remove it from both the Blogibot schedule and the WordPress cron system, preventing it from being created.

How does the RSS feed import work?

Blogibot can automatically import content from any RSS or Atom feed. You add feed sources in the Feed tab, configure import settings like frequency and filters, and the plugin automatically fetches new posts based on your schedule using WordPress cron.

Can I import from multiple RSS feeds?

Yes! You can add unlimited RSS/Atom feed sources. Each feed can have its own settings for import frequency, content filtering, category assignment, and more.

How does duplicate prevention work?

Blogibot tracks imported posts by their source URL, title, GUID, or content hash (you choose the method). This prevents the same post from being imported multiple times even if it appears in multiple feeds.

What is the Site Content Analyzer?

The Site Content Analyzer scans your existing WordPress content and uses AI to suggest relevant blog topics and ideas. It helps you create content that aligns with your site’s theme and fills content gaps.

Does the feed import affect my site performance?

No. Feed imports run in the background using WordPress cron system and are designed to be lightweight. You can control the frequency and limit the number of posts imported per fetch.

How do I get support?

For support questions, please contact us through our website at Wontonee.com.
